FirebaseProject.description: A `FirebaseProject` is the top-level Firebase entity. It is the container for Firebase Apps, Firebase Hosting sites, storage systems (Firebase Realtime Database, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Storage buckets), and other Firebase and Google Cloud resources. You create a `FirebaseProject` by calling AddFirebase and specifying an *existing* [Google Cloud `Project`](https://cloud.google.com/resource-manager/reference/rest/v1/projects). This adds Firebase resources to the existing Google Cloud `Project`. Since a FirebaseProject is actually also a Google Cloud `Project`, a `FirebaseProject` has the same underlying Google Cloud identifiers (`projectNumber` and `projectId`). This allows for easy interop with Google APIs.
